title: Conditional κ = 0.000744719882668682: 65 compatible retimings on PR290 kernels
body:
# Conditional κ = 0.000744719882668682: compatible PR289 retiming on PR290 kernels

This composes 65 kernel-disjoint extreme-frame retimings from #289 with all 450 collective kernel entries from #290. The exact conditional saving is `372359941334341/500000000000000000`, an improvement of `2691655527/500000000000000000` (approximately 0.000722869%) over #290's `0.000744714499357628`.

Of #289's 87 gates, 22 touch #290 kernel pivots or donors. Including all 87 passes the finite checks but gives the worse κ = `0.000744693355556140`. The mandatory composition checker derives the exact 65-gate subset from the original selection and rejects conflicting, omitted, altered, or incorrectly bound selections. The kernel entries are rebound to the actual retimed word and every changed count/hash is recomputed; independent κ gains are not added.

The stock, scalar additions, endpoints, kernel membership and entrance ranks are unchanged. There are 325 more five-stage calls at unchanged rank mass, but the paid-rank distribution has a lower concave cost and a better exact moment root. The original fallback envelope, three bootstrap levels, outer backoff and conditional interfaces are retained. Consumed intermediate frame obligations remain in the determinant inventory.

The pinned #290 manifest lists three absent discovery logs (`discovery/twin-census.log`, `discovery/coll/selG5.log`, `discovery/coll/families34.log`), so its original verifier stops at integrity. This patch removes those nonexistent entries and pins every actual file. A separate baseline replay with only that repair reproduced #290's original κ.

Validation: all 11 immutable stages passed locally — virtual, composition, raw, bit, kernel, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with inputs unchanged, corruption/omission controls, both rational moment engines, all 47 strict assembly inequalities, and adjacent-grid rejection. Final manifest SHA256: `ec5bd800c48c0a20237ef50ef1b10db162bbcf464da36605d9e5de2dc7ce2504`.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5-collective-kernels/verify.py --output /absolute/path/to/a/new/replay-directory
```

The output directory must be fresh and outside the package. Python 3.11+ and SymPy 1.14.0 are required. The verifier is network-free after dependencies are installed.

This is a compatibility selection and verified composition of public mechanisms, not an unconditional theorem, novel multiplication algorithm, or measured runtime speedup. The retained all-size compiler, common weighted chart, restored-row, selector, routing, prime-supply, precision/recovery, complex-symbolic and analytic interfaces remain assumptions. No global-optimality claim is made.

Credits: Rohan Gupta (#289), Chafik Boukhalfa (#290), DreamingOfClouds (#285/#276), Rohan Arun (#287), eumemic, Dugongue, Henry Grant, Jacob Sussman, Evan McKinney and the inherited lineage. Original notices, assistance disclosures and Apache-2.0 terms are preserved. This composition was prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
